name: reduced-wide-joint-original54-v1
lean_basis: FlatSpectrum CM64/65/66/67/68: exact observed-row coordinates, weighted full-coordinate projection, fixed-family inclusion and lossless indexed UInt16 observations
historical_scope: Previous source and numerical summaries retained after user-authorized raw-output cleanup. Their historical verification is not a new replay of deleted raw artifacts.
stage_barrier: Seal every case and all three training endpoints before scoring any heldout pool. Model refusal stays in the full case denominator; I/O or disk shortage stops execution.
tensor_encoding: RDLT6401: every mass and unknown raw-class entry as exact binary64, bound dictionary and digest; deterministic complete complex head reconstruction
raw_records: Every ordered train and validation row, original target, all class logits, exact maximizers, numerical certificate and conditional anchor coverage. No target enters prediction.
repeat: Independently rebuild frozen source and repeat every training and scoring phase. Recount saved raw rows and compare every deterministic input, model, trace, raw artifact and summary hash.
scope: No target-realizability or floating-point projection theorem. Flat spectrum supplies a head-capacity bound; the fixed input-only family supplies a separate structural prior. Historical transformer scores remain reference results, without new transformer training.
observation_encoding: All original states and labels stored as checked UInt16 words, decoded one original row at a time. Original program-major state and complete dictionary hashes and legacy probe admission remain unchanged. Separate comparison_buffer_bytes and comparison_refusal use complete packed-buffer admission. No candidate pruning or record deduplication.
